label: Phase 1 Tier 1 physics-informed features + per-section conformal
note: Tier 1 features per the 2026-06-22 strategy. V_t = max(0, h_c - GWL) uses a causal expanding-window minimum of head per section (no look-ahead). sigma_eff = gamma*z_mid - gamma_w*GWL with gamma = 18 kN/m^3, gamma_w = 9.81 kN/m^3; gwl_head treated directly as the head term per project baseline. V_t_x_fine_pct = V_t * fine_pct (clay-amplified inelastic switch). Per-section conformal uses Mondrian-style stratification: one quantile per section from val residuals. Cal n per section is 24 < 30 (Singh 2024 jackknife+ recommended for that regime); flagged but proceeded for v1.1. Section-well map, span, lags, split, model, and alpha inherit from run_001 baseline.
